final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT ma.player_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country), totals AS (SELECT death_country, SUM(group_count) AS country_total FROM grouped GROUP BY death_country) SELECT g.player_id, g.death_country, g.group_count, 1.0 * g.group_count / t.country_total AS share FROM grouped AS g JOIN totals AS t ON g.death_country = t.death_country ORDER BY share IS NULL, share DESC LIMIT 10
